note.zh-TW: 現行台灣報表稱為綜合損益表，多了其他綜合損益的部分，本課不教。
note.en: Current Taiwanese statements are titled statement of comprehensive income, which adds other comprehensive income; this course does not cover that part.

definition.zh-TW: 標題寫著起訖日期的報表，把這段時間入帳的收入與各類費用分組排列。從頂端的營業收入開始，每加減完一組就得到一層利益，課程版面共有五層，最底下那層是本期淨利。比較相鄰兩層差了多少，就知道利潤在哪一段減少最多。
definition.en: A statement whose heading gives a start date and an end date; it sorts the revenue and expenses recorded over that span into groups. Starting from revenue at the top, each group added or deducted yields one profit level, five in the course layout, with profit for the period at the bottom. Comparing neighbouring levels shows where along the way profit shrinks the most.
